profile_text.body:
Humane Intelligence is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 2022 and headquartered in Katy, Texas. The organization describes itself as dedicated to breaking down barriers to AI deployment for social good, and says it collaboratively designs and runs rigorous evaluations to make AI systems more accountable, responsible, and fair.

According to its website, Humane Intelligence offers AI red teaming events as a paid service using its own software, which it says was released under an open source software license in September 2026. It also offers AI contextual evaluations, including ontology-based contextual AI evaluations (OB-CAIE) under development in 2026, as a paid service. The organization ran bias bounties, with its final self-hosted bias bounty closing in November 2025 and a first bias bounty on the Zindi platform launching in August 2026. Its web application supports data collection for hosted red teaming events and contextual evaluation services, and a new client-facing software is stated to be available in October 2026.

No litigation cases or MCP servers are listed for the organization. Texas law exposure records list 126 entries for Humane Intelligence.
